purpose: Promote the exact Type-0x03 player-collision response and its nested Type-0x84 moving-child AnimationVM entries.

producer.name: ActorType03_PlayerCollisionHandler
producer.contract: On the gated player-collision path, convert the source actor to type 0x84, install animation 0x00122E16, clear its animation state, and clear the linked actor interaction byte.

streams.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_TYPE03_COLLISION_RESPONSE
decoded: Initial frame 0x147E and ED publication of actor type 0x84
Six F5 placements using ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_F5_MOVING_CHILD_BASE at 0x001B7F08 with payloads 0x10F8, 0xF010, 0xE8E8, 0x1808, 0xF8F0, and 0x0818
Embedded default moving-child entry at 0x00122E96 issues the zero-payload F5 at 0x00122E9E

streams.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_F5_MOVING_CHILD_SPAWN_ENTRY
decoded: F5 at 0x00122EE2 selects ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_F5_MOVING_CHILD at 0x001B837C and entry 0x00122EFE
EA at 0x00122EF8 transfers to the shared response loop entry 0x00122F06

streams.name: ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_F5_MOVING_CHILD_RESPONSE
decoded: Embedded loop entry at 0x00122F06 delays the repeated 0x144A-0x145E frame sequence with timer 0x07
EF at 0x00122F34 advances the frame delay

boundary_basis: Lossless AnimationDecoder output for each root and inline entry
EA terminal at 0x00122EDA and next independent root at 0x00122EE0
EA terminal at 0x00122EF8 and next independent entry at 0x00122EFE
F600 terminal at 0x00122F36 and established ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_CHILD at 0x00122F38
Embedded entries 0x00122E96 and 0x00122F06 remain aliases into their owning streams
